text: Partly because fame looks easier to reach than ever. Teenagers see people of their own age becoming well known overnight thanks to one video, and it seems like a shortcut to money and respect. There's also a need to be noticed in a world full of noise. The problem is that very few people think about the less glamorous side, like constant criticism.

tips.en: Becoming well known overnight thanks to one video is a clear example.
tips.kk: Becoming well known overnight thanks to one video — көрнекі.
tips.ru: Becoming well known overnight thanks to one video — наглядно.
tips.example: becoming well known overnight thanks to one video

tips.en: The less glamorous side, like constant criticism, balances the answer.
tips.kk: The less glamorous side, like constant criticism — теңгерім.
tips.ru: The less glamorous side, like constant criticism — баланс.
tips.example: the less glamorous side, like constant criticism

questions.question: Why do so many young people want to be famous?

text: Whether they want to or not, they are role models, because children copy what they see. So I think famous people have some responsibility for how they behave in public. At the same time, it's unfair to expect them to be perfect. Parents and teachers usually have much more influence, and it's better when children look up to people they actually know.

tips.en: Whether they want to or not, they are role models is a strong start.
tips.kk: Whether they want to or not, they are role models — күшті басталу.
tips.ru: Whether they want to or not, they are role models — сильный старт.
tips.example: Whether they want to or not, they are role models

tips.en: It's unfair to expect them to be perfect adds a fair caveat.
tips.kk: It's unfair to expect them to be perfect — салмақты ескерту.
tips.ru: It's unfair to expect them to be perfect — взвешенная оговорка.
tips.example: it's unfair to expect them to be perfect

questions.followUp: Who would be a better role model?
questions.question: Should celebrities be role models for young people?

text: Yes, I think they do. Being famous for your work doesn't mean the public owns your whole life. Photographing someone's children or following them on holiday is clearly going too far. That said, if a politician or a celebrity does something illegal or hypocritical, the media has a right to report it. The line should be between public interest and simple curiosity.

tips.en: Photographing someone's children … is clearly going too far makes it concrete.
tips.kk: Photographing someone's children … is clearly going too far — нақтылық.
tips.ru: Photographing someone's children … is clearly going too far — конкретика.

title.en: A clear example of the limit

tips.en: Between public interest and simple curiosity draws a precise line.
tips.kk: Between public interest and simple curiosity — дәл айырмашылық.
tips.ru: Between public interest and simple curiosity — точное различие.
tips.example: between public interest and simple curiosity

note.en: “Has a right to every part of your life”.

text: Traditional stars usually became famous for a talent, like acting or singing, and their lives felt quite distant. Influencers often become famous simply for sharing their daily lives, which makes them seem more like friends. That closeness is exactly why brands pay them so much. I don't think they'll replace film stars, but the two groups are becoming more similar every year.

tips.en: Famous for a talent versus sharing their daily lives is a clear contrast.
tips.kk: Famous for a talent … simply for sharing their daily lives — анық қарама-қайшылық.
tips.ru: Famous for a talent … simply for sharing their daily lives — чёткий контраст.
tips.example: simply for sharing their daily lives

tips.en: That closeness is exactly why brands pay them links cause and effect.
tips.kk: That closeness is exactly why brands pay them — себеп пен салдар байланысы.
tips.ru: That closeness is exactly why brands pay them — связь причины и следствия.
tips.example: That closeness is exactly why brands pay them so much

questions.followUp: Will they replace film and music stars?
questions.question: How are influencers different from traditional celebrities?

text: Compared with nurses or teachers, their salaries do seem unfair. But the market decides: a footballer or a singer brings in millions through tickets, advertising and broadcasts, so they get a share of that. Their careers are also short and risky. What I'd change is not their pay but how society values essential jobs, which are often badly paid.

tips.en: Their salaries do seem unfair. But the market decides shows two views.
tips.kk: Their salaries do seem unfair. But the market decides — екі көзқарас.
tips.ru: Their salaries do seem unfair. But the market decides — два взгляда.

tips.en: What I'd change is not their pay but … is an unexpected conclusion.
tips.kk: What I'd change is not their pay but … — күтпеген қорытынды.
tips.ru: What I'd change is not their pay but … — неожиданный вывод.
tips.example: What I'd change is not their pay but how society values essential jobs
